definition: a person who has just finished a degree
description: A young man in a black gown with a gold stole lands from a jump in a crouch on the lawn in front of an old stone university building, then springs up and stands with both arms raised high, holding a rolled diploma with a red ribbon and shouting with joy. His black square cap lies on the grass in front of him. Behind him a big crowd of graduates in gowns and families holding flowers and balloons cheer beside a wooden podium.
